correctness.rationale: Moment identities follow from beta law of a spherical coordinate; exact Taylor expansion cancels order 2 and gives the concave quartic form. Its optimum has sign F_d(q-1). Monotonicity of tF_d prime gives unique root for every d>=4; root sandwich yields sharp M^(1+sqrt2) growth. All 42 finite symbolic and quadrature tests in delivered check.py pass; tests supplement not replace the analytic proof.
